svg.title: Unified Capture Visual Design Suite (Family Cookbook Era 3)
svg.desc: Complete Era 3 visual design specification for What's for Supper Capture journeys: Entry Hub, collapsed Photo Staging, unified PDF/URL/Describe confirmation with restored top-right close control, Save-and-Return-Home ambient progress and notifications, paired human Duplicate Review, migrated Era 3 RecipeImportIssueSheet, French expansion proof, and High Contrast AAA adaptation.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3 · Capture & Import Suite
Save & Return Home · Standard AA & AAA
Save-and-forget capture across Photo, Link, Describe, PDF, and Shared File — one locked × cancel header, ambient Home progress, and paired duplicate review.
1 · Capture Entry Hub, Focused Photo Staging & Unified Direct-Entry Forms (412×915 · Locked × Header)

g.text: Snap 1 or more cookbook pages, or drop images
From any recipe website or blog
Name & family notes — we’ll draft it
• Visible "Take a photo" label + multi-page hint.
• Replaces rotated ArrowLeft with FileText + names PDF.
• Home trigger updates from "Photo or Link" →
Tap a photo to mark or clear the main dish cover.
• Hub collapses once staged; "+ Add photo" sits in grid.
• 800ms upload overlay kept for slow transfers; 202
returns straight to Home (no 10s countdown wait).
PDF recipe · up to 10 pages · 20 MiB
We’ll extract ingredients and steps in the background.
Add pinch of clove; double pastry
SAME SHELL FOR URL, DESCRIBE & .TXT BUNDLE
• URL & Describe show inline Sunlight duplicate
• No giant bottom Cancel button — top-right × cancels.
CLOSES THE PDF DEAD END (ONE EXIT GRAMMAR)
• Top-right × stays mounted on PDF confirmation and
discards the unsaved draft cleanly on tap.
• Optional: add [← Back] only when entered from Hub

svg.text: 2 · Save-and-Return-Home Async Feedback, Paired Duplicate Review & Era 3 Issue Sheet

g.text: A · AMBIENT IN-FLIGHT STATUS ON HOME (RIGHT AFTER SAVE → HOME)
Carry on — we’ll let you know when it’s in your library.
Tap to view · 1 possible duplicate flagged
C · PERSISTENT FAILURE BANNER (SSE recipe_failed · SINGLE DISMISS)
Recipe couldn’t be saved — Grandma’s Tourtière.
Your original file is still safe. Retry now or manage later in Settings.
WHY SAVE-AND-RETURN-HOME FITS THE NORTH STAR
• Eliminates the 10s countdown wait screen across Photo, URL, Describe & PDF.
• Ambient Home ribbon confirms intake + gives a 1-tap "+ Add another" shortcut for batch cooking sessions.
Discarded copies stay in Recycle Bin.
Add a note to request automatic repair.
All targets >= 48px · Full EN + FR copy
PAIRED DUPLICATE REVIEW + ERA 3 ISSUE SHEET UPGRADE
• Existing match is linked automatically — zero searching, and 1-tap resolution clears flags cleanly.
• Migrates RecipeImportIssueSheet off 44px targets, hardcoded English, and Era 2 alpha borders.
